before.content:
corepack pnpm --filter '@ji/web-app' test
corepack pnpm --filter '@ji/web-app' build
docker compose -p ji-relay -f deploy/relay/compose.yaml config --quiet
printf '%s\n' STAGE5_LOCAL_GATE_OK

after.content:
corepack pnpm --filter '@ji/web-app' test
corepack pnpm --filter '@ji/web-app' build
docker compose -p ji-relay -f deploy/relay/compose.yaml config --quiet
if [ -n "${JI_RELAY_BOOTSTRAP_FILE:-}" ]; then
  ./scripts/verify-stage5-ubuntu-compose.sh
fi
printf '%s\n' STAGE5_GATE_OK
